Demarai Gray unleashed a brilliant effort from distance following a set-piece situation, beating Hákon Valdimarsson to level the scores at 1-1. In the 35th minute, Aaron Hickey found the bottom corner with a left-footed finish to restore Brentford 's lead. The momentum stayed with the Bees , and in the 40th minute, Nathan Collins rose highest to head home a Jaidon Anthony cross, making it 1-3. Birmingham tried to respond through Gray and Luis Vázquez , but they couldn't find a way past the organized away defense. Mikkel Damsgaard added a fourth in the 70th minute following a lightning-fast break, once again assisted by Jaidon Anthony . Minutes later, Igor Thiago made it 1-5 from close range. The final blow arrived in the 77th minute when Nathan Collins secured his second header of the night from a corner, sealing a emphatic 1-6 victory for the top-flight side.
